description: Open WiFi : distribuzione per zona del traffico is a series of datasets listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Milano. Il dataset aggrega i valori giornalieri mediante una colonna per zona. Le zone dalla 1 alla 9 corrispondono ai 9 municipi amministrativi di Milano, la zona 10 invece corrisponde approssimativamente a una striscia che va da Piazza Castello a San Babila, e non include i ripetitori di zona 1. Coverage: Comune di Milano. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Milano. Its tags are openwifimilano, rendicontomandatoopenwifimilano, seriestorica, zona. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
